title: Roast Sweet Potato Bowl with Crispy Kale, Hummus, Olives & Feta

steps.text: Wash and dry sweet potatoes. Peel and cut each potato lengthwise into 4-6 wedges, depending on size, then transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Spread wedges out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes begin to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Place on a plate.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the plate with the tomatoes and set aside.
Place kale in a large bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat.
Remove sweet potatoes from the oven and flip using tongs. Add kale to the baking sheet, spreading it out over the sweet potatoes.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until kale is crispy and potatoes can be pierced easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide roasted sweet potatoes and crispy kale between bowls; top with hummus, tomatoes, olives, and feta. Enjoy!
